headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox edged the Detroit Tigers 4-3 in a thrilling victory, with Jordan Hicks earning the win in relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy, who pitched 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a strong 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 11, 2026, with a right forearm flexor strain. Seattle Mariners shortstop Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash.
